x: The Club gratefully acknowledges vests from Bill Luther (Erith), Cyril Pateman (Ceylon and S.W.19), H.

Cyril Pateman is a constant writer from Ceylon, saying how pleased he is to know that the Bels. are still to the fore. Eric Keyworth, a Lieut. in the R.A.P.C., we learn from his wife, has been posted to Jerusalem.

Cyril Pateman writes from Ceylon to say that it will not be long before he is back at the Hall where he hopes to be of assistance to us. Len Herbert has made several appearances this winter as he has been stationed not very far from the Hall.

Roberts and Cyril Pateman, and Tommy Morrell, proposed by Harry Shields and Arthur Penny, were duly elected to this great honour. Both of these popular members have put in many years of hard work for the Club and have been loyal team men.
It is regretted that there was a very poor response to the appeal in our last issue for donations to this cup. We are nevertheless grateful to C.
